name: Lvzhou Zhi Ai
source:
Twenty-eight years ago, a zombie virus outbreak plunged humanity’s home planet into a post-apocalyptic state.
Survivors banded together, and large refuge zones—called Oases—were established across the world.

From above, the metallic cities looked imposing, but the human survivors hid in the shadows.
A new social order emerged, with mercenary groups replacing the old enforcers of law and order.

I’m a member of the Black Bear Mercenary Group, just an ordinary scout, shuttling daily between the Oasis and the wasteland.
The monotonous grind of survival has left me numb and lonely.
Out of longing for the past, I built a robot modeled after my late sister—Alice.
The dream was beautiful, but the reality is that Alice is nothing like my sister, and the growing differences between them are giving me headaches.
People around us have started to notice, casting us glances that range from curious to judgmental.

Life in this post-apocalyptic world goes on. Beyond just surviving and working, what else is there for me to pursue?

[Translated from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1827940/Last_Lovers/]steam[/url]]
translation:
28年前，丧尸病毒暴发，人类赖以生存的星球陷入末世。
幸存者抱团求生，世界各地陆续建立起名为“绿洲”的大型避难区。

俯瞰之下，金属都市威严耸立，人类幸存者却躲在阴影之中。
新的社会秩序由此形成，佣兵团取代了昔日维护法律与治安的力量。

我是黑熊佣兵团的一员，一名普通的侦察兵，每天往返于绿洲与荒野之间。
单调的求生生活，让我变得麻木而孤独。
出于对过去的怀念，我以已故的姐姐为原型，造出了机器人——爱丽丝。
梦想很美好，可现实是，爱丽丝与姐姐截然不同，两者之间日益显露的差异让我越来越头疼。
周围的人也开始注意到这一点，向我们投来或好奇、或带着评判的目光。

末世中的生活还在继续。除了活着与工作，我还能追求些什么？

[译自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1827940/Last_Lovers/]Steam[/url]]
